fullContentHtml:
Short Information : UP Rojgar Sangam (Sewayojan) Portal has released the notification for the post of Multi Tasking Staff (MTS)  in the Department of Uttar Pradesh Chakbandi Vibhag. This recruitment has been issued for 81 posts. The online application process for UP Chakbandi Vibhag MTS Recruitment 2026 has started on 25 August 2026, and candidates can apply till 02 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UP Chakbandi Vibhag MTS Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

UP Rojgar Sangam (Sewayojan) Portal

UP Chakbandi Vibhag MTS Recruitment 2026

UP Chakbandi Vibhag Outsourcing Recruitment 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 August 2026
  • Last Date : 02 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : 0/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • No Application Fees For Any Candidates

UP Chakbandi Vibhag MTS Notification 2026 : Age Limit

  • Minimum Age : 20 Years
  • Maximum Age : 45 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per recruitment rules.
  • Use Age Calculate Tool – Click Here

UP Chakbandi Vibhag MTS 2026 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 81 Posts

Post Name No. of Posts District 
Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) 81
  • Basti, Siddharth Nagar, Saharanpur, Muzaffarnagar, Meerut, Bulandshahr, Bareilly, Shahjahanpur, Moradabad, Rampur, Bijnor, Amroha, Kanpur Nagar, Kanpur Dehat, Kannauj, Prayagraj, Lalitpur, Chitrakoot, Varanasi, Jaunpur, Ghazipur, Mirzapur, Sonbhadra, Azamgarh, Ballia, Gorakhpur, Deoria, Lucknow, Unnao, Rae Bareli, Hardoi, Gonda, Ayodhya, Sultanpur, Barabanki, Amethi.

 

UP Chakbandi Vibhag MTS Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates who have passed their Below SSC Level of examination from any recognized board will be considered for this recruitment.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

UP Chakbandi Vibhag MTS Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://sewayojan.up.nic.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the UP Rojgar Sangam (Sewayojan) Portal before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for UP Chakbandi Vibhag MTS recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे ।
